APPROVE
The loop body (its nested `if`s, boolean chains and the nested ternary) moves into `NestControllerMethods`/`NestDecision` with identical logic, swapping the order of the side-effect-free `UseGuards` checks and renaming `i` to `classAt`. That should drop `Nest` from 38 to well under 15 without changing behaviour or the lazy-evaluation order, though I couldn't find the repo to build it or confirm that `classDecorators` is a `List<Decorator>`.
